findings.title: No references, contract or checks needed
findings.detail: Genuine landlords must check your right to rent and normally want references and a contract. Skipping all of this suggests the person may not be able to let the property. The agent is offering a tenancy without the owner's knowledge or consent and asks you to keep it secret, so you would have no legal right to live there.

findings.title: The agent's identity changes
findings.detail: The name, company or role the agent gives is not consistent across the conversation. The person says they are only a short-stay guest, yet offers a tenancy as if they were the owner or an authorised agent, which contradicts the listing details.
